title: I love Schmigadoon! I love theatre #Schmigadoon #Schmigadoonmusical #...
transcript: The theatre girlies already know this but Schmigadoon! is going to be our musical. And the official broadway cast is here. And it's so good. I love Schmigadoon! It is the perfect television show for theatre people. There's so many easter eggs and homages and just so many things that are tailor made for us. I've watched it so many times and I drove down to DC. To see the first production of Schmigadoon! They Did a two week run last february. I really, really, deeply loved it. It was exactly what I wanted a Schmigadoon! musical to be. It had all my favorite moments and songs from season one. Great dancing, great book, insane cast. And most of the cast is returning to the show for its broadway run. A few roles have changed, a few people have been added, but honestly, like, what an insane cast. Ana Gasteyer was not in the DC Production, but I am obsessed with her. She's so funny. She's gonna be perfect, perfect, perfect, perfect for mildred. I love it so much. Max Clayton was I believe, in the ensemble of the DC Production But now he's coming in as a principal as danny the Aaron Tviet role from the TV Show. Max is such a showman. He was the harold hill cover in the music man a couple of years ago. Like, he's amazing, and I think he's going to be so great in this role. I'm thrilled for him, and i'm thrilled that we get to see it. It also has a really strong ensemble of really funny, really dancey people, including afra and nathan, two of my faves. Both in pirates of penzance last season, another funny, dancey show. I think Schmigadoon! is gonna be so big and so broadway and so fun. previews start april 4th so we have a little time. But if you haven't watched Schmigadoon! do it. this is a show, but you just. You have to. You have to watch it. You have to watch it. my main goal of Schmigadoon! on broadway is that it is the biggest hit of all time so that we get season three. Please give me season three.
